The term is October 1, 2025 through May 29, 2026. The Board is ratifying this agreement, which means approving it after it was already in place.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - The Teaching Well - Garfield Elementary School

enrichment.headline: Approves after the fact up to $45,700 for the Epicenter charter oversight software platform
enrichment.summary: The Institute for Excellence, doing business as National Charter Schools Institute, will provide the Epicenter platform, with setup and technical support. The Office of Charter Schools will use it to track data and compliance documents on charter governance, admissions, finances, enrollment and teacher credentialing. The term is July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026. The Board is ratifying this agreement, which means approving it after it was already in place.

vendor.name: The Institute for Excellence dba National Charter Schools Institute (Epicenter)

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement - National Charter Schools Institute - Charter Schools Office
